description: This file is a PHP class that manages the admin sale returns functionality in an OpenCart e-commerce platform. It contains methods for listing, viewing, creating, editing, deleting, and processing the history of product return requests within the admin interface.

classes.name: Returns
classes.description: Controller class managing the admin sale returns operations, including listing, form handling, saving, deleting, and handling history of product returns.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the main returns page, loads language, sets page title, builds breadcrumb and URL, and displays the list view along with return statuses.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list of returns by invoking getList method, used in AJAX or direct requests.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches and prepares the list of return records based on filters, sorting, and pagination, and renders the 'sale/returns_list' view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a return, populating data as needed.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving (adding or editing) a return record, including validation and permission checks.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected return records after permission validation.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Displays the history of a specific return.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Retrieves and formats the historical comments and statuses for a return, with pagination.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a new history comment/status to a return record.
